dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: Everyone, gather in the living room. The air feels heavy, no one is shouting or running away.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: For the first time, everyone is facing the truth together.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: I guess I will start.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Sorry for pretending to ignore everything.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: I understand it's annoying and disheartening to hear someone ignore problems.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: I just don't know what to do, do I just lie down, and yet the maggots eat my skin, or do I fight back?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Fighting back is tiring, I am exhausted. So tired from doing anything.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Do I scream! Because most days I feel like screaming, even now.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: I am so tired.  But I want to keep being your guys' friends.

dialogue.speaker: Garret
dialogue.text: ..ah, screw it.

dialogue.speaker: Garret
dialogue.text: I’ve been thinking about leaving. Going home, or just… disappearing.

dialogue.speaker: Garret
dialogue.text: Part of me still thinks it would be easier.

dialogue.speaker: Garret
dialogue.text: Taking a plane and starting a new life. I’d be broke, homeless… but it’s possible.

dialogue.speaker: Garret
dialogue.text: But running won’t fix anything. It’d probably make it worse.

dialogue.speaker: Garret
dialogue.text: If I run away, I’ll lose people I care about. And I don’t want to lose you guys.

dialogue.speaker: Maxwell
dialogue.text: Oh, you guys are looking at me!

dialogue.speaker: Maxwell
dialogue.text: I already had my sappy cry talk earlier, but I'll..

dialogue.speaker: Maxwell
dialogue.text: Say one thing. I am going to change, I just need time, but you guys are cool and I want to be your friends.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: I mentioned this already outside, but here we go

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: I am scared. More than I want to admit.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: But standing here and listening to you guys. I know I am not alone.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: Even if the world shifts around us. I know we will be here for each other.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: No one has all the answers. But for the first time, you’re not facing the future alone.
